dedupe_keys.name: python multicriteria zonation python workflow for multi criteria landslide susceptibility zonation ahp weighted linear combination quantile classification

description: Polina Lemenkova and Abdullah Can Zülfikar publish a scripted landslide-susceptibility zonation workflow. Zenodo archives version 1.0.1 under MIT and links an MIT-licensed repository. Python combines analytic-hierarchy weights, raster reclassification, weighted linear combination and quantile classes with GRASS GIS, GDAL and GMT. The repository describes slope, drainage, lithology, faults and rainfall factors. Its zonation rasters can feed road, settlement and utility landslide-exposure scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage depends on user-supplied geospatial layers and chosen study boundary, not a continuously updated hazard map. A limitation is that expert pairwise weights, class breaks and input resolution can change the final zones; susceptibility is not an event probability or engineering slope-stability test. Neither archive nor dependencies were installed, and no map or consistency ratio was recalculated.
